errors.signature: fxc.exe : The system cannot find the file specified / 'fxc' is not recognized
errors.cause: The Windows SDK shader compiler is not on PATH; the versioned Windows Kits directory is not searched.
errors.fix: Enumerate C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\bin\10.0.*\x64\fxc.exe, pick the newest version, and invoke it by absolute path. Do not add the SDK bin directory to PATH globally.
errors.verify: fxc.exe /? prints the compiler banner; the build log shows the absolute path used.

errors.signature: Error: spawn ENOENT in an MCP client or Node child_process
errors.cause: The client launched a bare command name and the process environment has no PATH entry for it.
errors.fix: Resolve the executable with where.exe (or Get-Command) and store the absolute path in the MCP server configuration. Use the same absolute path for the interpreter and the script.
errors.verify: The MCP server starts from a shell with an empty PATH; the configured path is absolute and exists.

errors.signature: Interceptor.attach succeeds but onEnter never fires; the game behaves normally
errors.cause: The hooked wrapper/constructor is not on the executed path, or the game uses a different module/thread/copy of the object.
errors.fix: Apply the Downstream Sink Protocol: attach a counter and backtrace at Present()/EndScene/UI sink, walk the stack to the real producer, and hook that leaf function. Confirm the module base and RVA.
errors.verify: The sink counter advances and the leaf hook logs the expected arguments; disabling the hook restores the original behavior.

errors.signature: Guest geometry slides or swims against the host camera; near objects lag behind far objects
errors.cause: The guest pose is applied without the camera matrix, or the host/guest depth conventions or units differ.
errors.fix: Embed the guest view-projection and camera world matrix in the shared-memory header; reproject with the inverse guest VP and the host VP; convert units once; add the one-frame pose-lag term. Validate with fake_host_d3d11.exe.
errors.verify: A static guest landmark stays on the same host pixel during a pure camera rotation; a translation test keeps the floor contact point stable.

errors.signature: Windows Defender flags a PyInstaller one-file mod installer as Trojan:Win32/Wacatac or similar
errors.cause: One-file self-extractors unpack to a temp directory and execute, a pattern that matches generic heuristics; the signature is usually a false positive.
errors.fix: Ship a one-folder build (PyInstaller --onedir) instead of --onefile, sign the executable if possible, publish SHA256SUMS, and document the expected hash. Do not tell users to disable Defender.
errors.verify: The folder build scans clean on VirusTotal (or the vendor confirms the false positive); the published hash matches the downloaded file.

errors.signature: ReShade depth effects are inverted, sky is near, or AO/DOF works inside-out
errors.cause: The host uses a reversed-Z depth buffer and the shader assumes standard 0..1 depth.
errors.fix: Set the depth-reversed flag (GTA V, UE4/5, many D3D11/12 titles) and linearize with near*far/(near + raw*(far-near)); verify with a readback.
errors.verify: A near object reads a smaller linear depth than a far object; fake_host_d3d11.exe passes both draw orders.

errors.signature: Pose or depth values jump, matrices contain impossible values, or the reader sees half an update
errors.cause: The reader copied the payload while the writer was updating it, or the sequence counter was not checked.
errors.fix: Use the seqlock protocol: writer stores odd seq, payload, even seq; reader retries when seq is odd or changed. Keep the payload trivially copyable and the sequence 32-bit atomic.
errors.verify: ipc_link_test.exe passes 50,000 frames with no torn read; a deliberate writer pause still yields a clean previous frame.

errors.signature: Two overlays fight for dxgi.dll/d3d11.dll, or the game loads the proxy twice and hooks fire twice
errors.cause: Two tools claim the same proxy slot, or the loader is copied into both the game root and a subdirectory.
errors.fix: Keep one owner per proxy name; check loaded modules before injecting; use the loader's documented proxy name and remove duplicate copies.
errors.verify: The module list shows one instance of the proxy; the hook counter advances once per frame.
